preconditions.description: The jumble must be a string.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(dictionary, list) and all(isinstance(word, str) for word in dictionary)
preconditions.description: The dictionary must be a list of strings.
The jumble must contain at least one character.

postconditions.expression: all(word in dictionary for word in stdout)
postconditions.description: All words in the output must be present in the dictionary.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(word) == sorted(jumble) for word in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each word in the output must be an anagram of the jumble.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == len([word for word in dictionary if sorted(word) == sorted(jumble)])
postconditions.description: The output must contain all and only the words from the dictionary that are anagrams of the jumble.
